programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: The Travel Show is a BBC travel programme. The new programme launched in February 2014,[1] and is the immediate successor of long standing travel programme, Fast Track. Utilising a network of correspondents in London, Tokyo, Sydney, New York and Kuala Lumpur, the programme aims to provide unique insight into the world of travel. It first aired in the UK in late February, after Winter Olympics coverage, in a Friday morning slot on BBC Two. A Sunday evening slot was also added on the BBC News channel in April 2014 and BBC iPlayer.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: Breadwinners
programme.desc: Two ducks with thin legs and round faces, SwaySway and Buhdeuce, are best friends. They fly around the water-based planet Pondgea in a rocket-powered van and deliver fresh bread to its citizens. They often find themselves in awkward and funny situations, and sometimes their workdays are quite dangerous. They find new friends, deal with opponents and have fun, making sure Pondgea always receive fresh bread on time.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Как у них получилось?
programme.desc: Шоу журналиста Александра Мурашева, в котором он НЕ говорит о "прекрасной России будущего" в теории. Александр Мурашев отправляется в страны, где когда-то можно было найти самые болезненные для России проблемы: от свалок размером с города до коррупции и тюремной системы. И выясняет как у них получилось эти проблемы решить. В первой части сезона вместе с Александром Мурашевым вы побываете в Японии, Сингапуре, Тайване и Южной Корее.

programme.title: Свидетели Путина
programme.desc: События фильма начинаются 31 декабря 1999 года, когда россиянам представили их нового президента. Фильм основан на уникальных и строго документальных свидетельствах истинных причин и последствий операции "преемник", в результате которой россия оказалась с президентом, который правит страной до сих пор. Главными героями фильма являются Михаил Горбачев, Борис Ельцин, Владимир Путин и русский народ, который как всегда безмолвствует.

programme.title: Балтийский путь
programme.desc: Это фильмы о людях, живущих в Латвии, Литве и Эстонии. Они говорят на разных языках, но все — об одном и том же: о том, что волнует, огорчает или радует каждого из нас. Мы не делим жизнь на политику и всё остальное — мы просто говорим о самом важном.

programme.title: DW.#вТРЕНДde
programme.desc: Интервью с журналисткой Ксенией Лученко.

programme.title: Америка. Большое путешествие
programme.desc: Здесь выращивают больше всего попкорна в стране. Из старых машин сооружают новое чудо света. Знают, как разговаривать с коровами и беречь каждый сантиметр плодородных земель. Это настоящая американская глубинка. Родина миллиардера Уоррена Баффета, который до сих пор не променял штат ни на какой другой. Небраска - скромная, но отнюдь не безликая. Она умеет удивлять самыми простыми и бытовыми вещами.

programme.title: Интервью
programme.desc: Варвара Шмыкова - актриса, получившая широкую известность после роли в сериале "Чики". Из-за высказываний в поддержку Алексея Навального она лишилась ролей в фильмах и спектаклях, а в 2022 году заняла жесткую антивоенную позицию и уехала из России. Шмыкова снялась в фильме Андрея Звягинцева "Минотавр", который получил Гран-при Каннского фестиваля. Настоящее Время поговорило с актрисой о "Минотавре", Звягинцеве и его победной речи в Каннах, войне, государственной машине, современном российском кино и съемках в европейских картинах.

programme.title: Система
programme.desc: Денис Мантуров создал любимую игрушку Путина - лимузин "Аурус". После этого Мантуров стал вторым по значимости человеком в правительстве России и попал в список преемников Путина. Еще Мантуров отвечает за всю военную промышленность. Благодаря оборонке чиновник обзавелся связями в путинском окружении, а затем - дорогой недвижимостью и впечатляющей коллекцией ретро-автомобилей. Еще у Мантурова есть летающий "Аурус", генеральский кабриолет и личный ассистент по жилищным вопросам, который по совместительству производит оружие для российской армии. Об этом и многом другом мы рассказываем в нашем расследовании.

programme.title: Сибириада
programme.desc: Жители Напаса называют свой посёлок \"пупом Земли\", считая, что тот географически распложен в самом центре страны. На самом деле он затерян в сибирской тайге и болотах. Вертолёт - единственная связь с большой землёй. Когда-то Напас считали столицей народов Севера. Здесь охотились селькупы, ловили рыбу ханты, пасли стада оленей эвенки. Но постепенно жизнь здесь стала угасать. Коренные народы обрусели, забросили исконные промыслы, забытыми оказались языки и самобытная культура. Оставшиеся в посёлке люди пытаются выжить в суровых условиях этого дикого края.

programme.title: Евродонбасс
programme.desc: Документальный фильм показывает зарубежное наследие Мариуполя, Лисичанска, Дружковки и Нью-Йорка. Съемочная группа обнаружила и оживила уникальные, но малоизвестные архивные материалы Донбасса XIX века. Эксперты, историки и местные жители делятся своими рассказами и свидетельствами об истории региона, которая была тщательно уничтожена и искажена советскими властями. Вскоре после съемок почти все локации были уничтожены российскими ракетами. "Евродонбасс".

programme.title: Открой Молдову
programme.desc: Почему молодые люди из разных стран выбирают молдавские вузы? В этом выпуске — история студентки, которая каждую неделю ездит на учебу из Румынии в Кишинев, будущих врачей из Индии и иностранных студентов, получающих практический опыт в больницах страны.

programme.title: DW. Интервью
programme.desc: Интервью с известными политиками, интеллектуалами, общественными деятелями из России, Европы и США.

programme.title: Европа в фокусе
programme.desc: Актуальные события стран Европы.

programme.title: Сибириада
programme.desc: Жители Напаса называют свой посёлок \"пупом Земли\", считая, что тот географически распложен в самом центре страны. На самом деле он затерян в сибирской тайге и болотах. Вертолёт - единственная связь с большой землёй. Когда-то Напас считали столицей народов Севера. Здесь охотились селькупы, ловили рыбу ханты, пасли стада оленей эвенки. Но постепенно жизнь здесь стала угасать. Коренные народы обрусели, забросили исконные промыслы, забытыми оказались языки и самобытная культура. Оставшиеся в посёлке люди пытаются выжить в суровых условиях этого дикого края.

programme.title: Человек имеет право
programme.desc: В программе Марьяны Торочешниковой юристы, правозащитники, гражданские активисты и обычные граждане подводят главные итоги недели.

programme.title: Крым.Реалии
programme.desc: Программа о событиях в Крыму.

programme.title: Донбасс реалии
programme.desc: Восток Украины – спец. репортажи из зоны конфликта.

programme.title: Искусство в деталях
programme.desc: Передача "Искусство в деталях" глубоко исследует международную креативную сцену, раскрывая новые идеи и объясняя культурные феномены, которые формируют нашу историю, настоящее и будущее. programme.title: Initials SG
programme.desc: "Struggling actor" is a euphemism for 50-year-old suave, nevertheless professionally washed-up Argentinian Sergio Garces, who is still reminiscing about a long-forgotten cover album of Serge Gainsbourg's songs he had recorded in his youth. To him, the two of them share not only a slight resemblance and common initials, but the singer's enticing aura as well. As the World Cup final between Argentina and Germany is closing in, plunging Buenos Aires in anticipation frenzy, Sergio's streak of ridiculously bad luck is about to reach a record-high. A sui generis blend of offbeat dramedy, crime caper and surreal dark comedy, set against a backdrop of dead-serious sarcasm.

programme.title: The Lookout
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere.

programme.title: That's What I Am
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties."

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale
programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship.

programme.title: The Lavender Hill Mob
programme.desc: Classic Ealing comedy from director Charles Crichton. Alec Guinness stars as a mild-mannered transporter of gold bullion. He has been doing the job for the past 20 years honestly enough, but suddenly decides to steal a million pounds. He enlists the help of paperweight manufacturer Stanley Holloway and the men hijack the bank's armoured car. Once in their hands, the gold bars are melted down and formed into small, souvenir Eiffel Towers. But after the booty is smuggled out to Paris, it is purchased by a group of English schoolgirls. As a result of their pleading with the girls, the gang retrieve all but one of the towers. But the last one is in the hands of a very determined student, and she refuses to part with it... With Sid James, Alfie Bass and Majorie Fielding.

programme.title: The Queen
programme.desc: Winner of the Academy Award for Best Actress, Dame Helen Mirren gives a spellbinding performance in THE QUEEN, the provocative story behind one of the most public tragedies of our time - the sudden death of Princess Diana. In the wake of Diana's death, the very private and tradition-bound Queen Elizabeth II (Mirren) finds herself in conflict with the new Prime Minister, the slickly modern and image-conscious Tony Blair (Michael Sheen). THE QUEEN takes you inside the private chambers of the Royal Family and the British government for a captivating look at a vulnerable human being in her darkest hour, as a nation grieving for its People's Princess waits to see what its leaders will do.

programme.title: All Our Desires
programme.desc: Moved by the plight of the mother of her daughter's school friend, a young judge facing an incurable disease teams up with an older colleague in order to fight against financial companies that exploit the poor.

programme.title: The Chef's Wife
programme.desc: The wife of a successful chef feels unfulfilled in her rôle as dining-room hostess and consults career counselor, who is herself dissatisfied by her useful but mundane place in the scheme of things. Without meaning to, the two women find their lives growing tangled together, with ever more complex tragicomic consequences.

programme.title: Madame de Sevigne
programme.desc: Gwen Cooper's unassuming fiance, Rhys, is drawn into the dangerous world of Torchwood this week and, speaking to Eve Myles (Gwen Cooper) and Kai Owen (Rhys Williams), Torchwood Declassified looks at how their relationship has grown since she joined the secret underground team, and just how he handles being a part of their latest mission. Writer Catherine Tregenna and executive producer Russell T Davies also talk about how they created one of Torchwood's most exciting alien creatures yet, and the CGI teams show the processes of how they took this from script to screen.

programme.title: My Friend from the Park
programme.desc: Liz, a new mother, meets Rosa and they end up becoming good friends. However, their friendship takes an unexpected turn as Liz is pulled into a life of crime and instability.

programme.title: Rosie
programme.desc: ROSIE tells the story of a mother trying to protect her family after their landlord sells their rented home and they become homeless. Finding a room, even for a night, is a tough job and finding somewhere permanent to live is even harder. Within the confines of their car, Rosie (Sarah Greene), and John Paul (Moe Dunford) strive to maintain a loving home while shielding their young family from the reality of the situation around them. Rosie examines how even in times of crises, the love and strength of a family can endure.

programme.title: Little One
programme.desc: When a happy young couple welcome their first child, their four new grandparents start vying for exclusive control of the baby in a rivalry that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Writer-director Andrea Arnold's (Fish Tank, Red Road, American Honey) Film4-funded, radical adaptation (co-written by Olivia Hetreed) of Emily Brontë's classic romantic novel, starring Kaya Scodelario (Skins) as Cathy and James Howson (in his screen debut) as Heathcliffe. On a trip to Liverpool, Mr Earnshaw (Paul Hilton) offers a young black street-dweller, Heathcliffe (Solomon Glave), a chance to escape his poverty and come to live with him and his two children at his remote farm. He'll have to work, of course, but, despite the colour of his skin, he will be treated as equal. Well, that's the promise, and it's kept, but the Yorkshire moors were a tough place from which to eke an existence in the 19th century; and as for equality... he's not exactly immediately welcomed by his new 'siblings'. However, he does quickly bond with the young Cathy (Shannon Beer) and the two develop a passionate friendship, which only serves to stoke the ire of her brother Hindley (Lee Shaw). But, as the two grow, Cathy (Scodelario) and Heathcliffe (Howson) find themselves caught in a tempest of obsessive love, anger and revenge. Robbie Ryan's cinematography starkly captures the raw nature of those weather-beaten uplands - an effect further enhanced by the lack of a musical score. The film was nominated for Golden Lion at the 2011 Venice Film Festival.

programme.title: Dead Man's Shoes
programme.desc: Shane Meadows' thriller is set in a small, bleak Derbyshire town. After seven years in the army, Richard (Paddy Considine) returns to find out what happened to his beloved brother Anthony (Toby Kebbell), who latched on to the local drugs cartel and became the butt of their cruelty. As Richard begins to take revenge against the gang, led by Sonny (Gary Stretch), the story of Anthony's life and fate unfolds through flashback and revelations. This screening is introduced by the director.

programme.title: Pretty Red Dress
programme.desc: Ex-con Travis, aspiring performer Candice and their 14-year-old daughter Kenisha all have relationships with the same red dress. For Candice, it's her audition outfit for a Tina Turner musical and a ticket to a different life. For Kenisha, it's symbolic of a kind of femininity she doesn't get. So when Travis is discovered wearing the dress, it sends the family spinning.

programme.title: Spell
programme.desc: Following the unexpected death of his fiancee, an American illustrator embarks on a soul-searching journey across the isolated Icelandic countryside, only to become drawn into a supernatural world of ancient runes and secrets. In his vulnerable state, he meets a powerful magician who can raise the dead, and locals who convince him to proceed with the ritual. Very dangerous, unless it's all in his head.

programme.title: Meet the Orangutans
programme.desc: Meet the Orangutans is a window into the extraordinary daily drama of the world's oldest Orangutan Sanctuary. From babies being bottle-fed and wearing nappies, to teenagers being taught how to climb trees, and wounded Orangutans arriving at the sanctuary needing urgent veterinary care, there is never a dull moment. The human carers, run by eccentric Brit Sue Sheward, are every bit as colourful too, and the jury's still out on who rules the roost - the staff or the apes.

programme.title: Animal Cribs
programme.desc: American animal TV series with designer Antonio Ballatore own show creating the perfect space for pet owning families. Believing that if dad can have a "man cave" and mum a "she shed" then surely there is such thing as a animal crib?! Antonio's passion for design and animals shines through throughout every episode. Joined by project manager Grace and their trusty companion Chewie the Bulldog they produce the most fantastic spaces for both pets and their owners. Pets include Chinchillas, dogs, cats and snakes and possibly many more.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: How Do Animals Do That?
programme.desc: How Do Animals Do That is a documentary series where experts answer various questions about the animal kingdom, revealing some amazing fun facts along the way. Animals have super powers humans can only dream of, they can do incredible things. The series provides answers to the questions how they do it and why. Find out why moths are attracted to flames, why turtles cry, why sea otters bond with stones, and why dogs wag their tails.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: Wild Costa Rica
programme.desc: Explore the incredible creatures that survive in the wild lands of Costa Rica. From bizarre and unique monkey rituals to a bat that catches fish to a sloth with an unusual set of friends, journey through an extraordinary land where nature continues to surprise and delight.

programme.title: Cats of Claw Hill
programme.desc: Cats of Claw Hill is an amazing documentary series revolving around the magic world of cats, their private lives and their everyday routine. People have no idea what's going on when they are not at home. So this series gives the viewers a look at the secret lives of their cats, their scandals, anarchy and reveals cats' true faces. The feline lives are filmed from a cat's eye view in six different households. The cats do their regular cats stuff, patrol the streets and explore their residence, visit the vet. The series is a great source of informative, scientific data about the complex world of cat behaviour.

programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Pandamonium
programme.desc: The pandas in the Wolong Panda Reserve in China have been followed by camera teams for a year. Thanks to the pioneering research performed at the reserve, 16 cubs have been born.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: Preparations for winter are underway in Alaska's Arctic National Wildlife Refuge. In less than three weeks, the refuge will be covered in snow, making transport and hunting near impossible. Bob prepares his gear for the first hunt of the season but runs into trouble when his boat engine malfunctions. Heimo spots a gigantic bull moose - the one animal that can provide enough meat for himself and his wife throughout the entire winter. After tracking the animal to a gravel bar, Heimo deploys his signature moose call to draw it out into the open. Later, a fourth family - Tyler and Ashley Selden - arrive at their cabin to find it flooded by a rising river. After working to catch nearly 400 salmon, the young couple is forced to go on the offensive after a bear ransacks their fish pile and threatens the only means of keeping their dog team fed through winter.

programme.title: Animal ER
programme.desc: Owners Lisa and Callu are worried about Merlin, a Great Dane who goes over on his front toes when he walks. Neurologist Annette Wessman suspects a problem in his spine or skull.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Dogs: The Untold Story is an amazing documentary series providing us with unbelievable stories, research results and facts about our best friends, healers and protectors- dogs. They have evolved from predators to favourite pets, adored by millions people all over the world. They can understand people and even talk to them, they have been by human's side for more than 33.000 years. Dogs are actually more incredible than anyone has ever imagined.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

Together they interview witnesses and gather evidence, uncovering the fact behind the fiction to decipher what or who is causing the hauntings. These paranormal places are scattered across America and have long claimed to have spooky pasts; the team hope they can solve the mysteries once and for all. Reality series.

programme.title: The Dead Files
programme.desc: On "The Dead Files," Cindy Kaza, an evidential medium, and Steve DiSchiavi, a retired NYPD homicide detective, join forces to investigate paranormal activity in haunted locations across the United States. Their unique talents combine to create a powerful team that aims to unravel the mysteries of the supernatural world. With a blend of psychic intuition and investigative skills, Kaza and DiSchiavi explored the boundaries between the living and the dead, seeking answers to unexplained phenomena that defy conventional explanations. Their captivating narratives offer viewers a glimpse into the uncharted territories of the afterlife, bridging the gap between this world and the next.

programme.title: Portals To Hell
programme.desc: Growing up around Ozzy Osbourne must have been, at times, a frightening ordeal for Jack Osbourne, however that hasn't stopped the son of the Prince of Darkness teaming up with paranormal investigator Katrina Weidman, to explore infamous, haunted locations. In each episode of this frightening reality series, Jack and Katrina head to a new place with a chilling history, and each sinister site is said to be a portal to the depths of the underworld. With the help of a team of experts and armed with unique technology, the pair thoroughly examine each new haunting site, hoping to unearth the truth behind their respective mysterious pasts.

programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot
programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it.

programme.title: Edge of Alaska
programme.desc: Hidden deep in the wilderness of eastern Alaska and built during the Gold Rush as Alaska's original 'Sin City', only 42 residents currently brave the extreme conditions in McCarthy. It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme?

The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature.

The guys are members of the paranormal investigation group- T.A.P.S., which Hawes founded, and they helped to create ''United Paranormal Research Organization (UPRO)'', which aims to be a global paranormal investigation organization that keeps local organizations connected. Using state-of-the-art technology, strict methodology and local contacts, the team tracks down the source of the unexplained phenomena and cracks each outrageous case.

programme.title: Ice Cold Gold
programme.desc: The miners are almost at season's end. With winter closing in and time running out, Josh and Eric arrive in Eqi, north of the Arctic Circle, for one last shot at gold, while the rest of the team focuses on dredging for rubies the Upper Lake area with Chad. Chad faces scorn once the team discovers that Chad and Josh dropped the dredge in an area that's not even on their claim. And, the miners are unhappy when they're forced to move the quarter-ton machine half a mile before they can begin their search for rubies. Eric's research has him convinced that there are riches in Eqi, and he and Josh must venture into the unknown to seek a new deposit during terrible, trapping weather. Is the dredge worth the investment, and does Chad's reputation hit rock bottom? Can Josh and Eric uncover a mountain of gold before Greenland sends them packing? The pressure is on for the miners as time and patience runs out.

programme.title: Ice Cold Gold
programme.desc: ICE COLD GOLD spotlights a spirited team of miners who are among the first Americans to prospect for precious metals and gems in parts of Greenland where humans never have set foot before. The six-part series follows eight men who leave behind their families, friends and homeland to strike it rich against all odds while struggling to survive against the harshest of conditions. Greenland's a veritable beast, but the motley crew of ICE COLD GOLD miners is up for the challenge. Each thinks he has what it takes to walk away with gold, rubies and sapphires before winter and large mining companies swoop in. What transpires as the miners cope with the unpredictable, harsh unknown? Are they humbled by their journey? Do their personalities get in the way? Most importantly, do they strike ICE COLD GOLD?ed ice sheets.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Expedition Unknown chronicles the adventures of Josh Gates as he investigates iconic mysteries across the globe. Gates begins by interviewing key eyewitnesses and uncovering recent developments in the story, then springboards into a fully immersive exploration. This authentic, roughshod adventure leads Gates closer to the truth behind these unanswered global enigmas, such as the disappearance of Amelia Earhart's plane. programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.desc: Baylen Out Loud follows the journey of Baylen Dupree, a young woman living with an extreme case of Tourette Syndrome. Despite her daily challenges, Baylen and her family aren't afraid to laugh and embrace the chaos that makes their everyday lives in West Virginia unique. With Baylen yearning for independence, she'll need to rely less on her family as she takes steps toward being in the world on her own.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress With Tan France
programme.desc: Sarah's determined that her fiancé's Asian traditions play a big part in their wedding. Meanwhile, Tan helps Tara find a dress that's both sexy and classy!

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress With Tan France
programme.desc: Tan attempts to juggle the dreams of not one, but two brides-to-be! Plus, vintage-loving Charlotte is looking for a sustainable dress.

programme.title: 1000-lb Sisters
programme.desc: With an average weight of over 1000lbs, nothing can support the Slaton sisters like they can support each other. With hopes of a healthier life, the sisters embark on a journey to drop enough weight that they qualify for a life changing bariatric surgery. Without the surgery, Amy will never be able to become a mother like she dreams of, and Tammy will be bedridden. After meeting with medical experts, the sisters strive to reach their goal but drama ensues as they struggle to stick to their healthy diets. Will the Slaton sisters stay on the right track and turn their lifestyles around?

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: Unexpected: Teenage & Pregnant
programme.desc: This programme aims to explore the complicated issues that can happen when teenage pregnancy suddenly happens. Focusing on three girls, the camera captures each trimester and the first few weeks of parenthood. Each couple is completely unprepared for what is about to happen when they become parents which is where each set of grandparents comes in handy. Tensions become high as everyone has their own set of rules on what the "perfect" parent should be like and what the future beholds for the young parents to be.

programme.title: Match Me Abroad
programme.desc: After failing to find a soulmate in the US, Americans take the search overseas for a chance at happiness. Expert matchmakers pull out all the stops to connect these hopeful romantics to their one true love.

programme.title: Addicted To Marriage
programme.desc: Addicted to Marriage follows the lives of four intriguing women who love to get married. Meet Monette, Shae, Amy, and Kecia, who collectively have been down the aisle a total of 20 times! Each marriage enthusiast is ready to say "I do" again, but are the men in their lives ready? Some of the women know exactly what they want in a future marriage while others struggle with their pasts. One of the brides-to-be has a list she refers to as the 'Triple A': attention, affection and appreciation whereas others grapple with revealing how many times they've said 'I do' because of their lurking insecurities of potentially failing at yet another marriage. The women know they trust quickly and love hard but the relationship highs are often met with intense drama and scrutiny by the men they love. Will their willingness for a happy ending with Prince Charming push the men in their life away or will they finally have the happily ever after they have been longing for?

programme.title: Hayley Ever After
programme.desc: Reality Show. Esteemed bridal designer, Hayley Paige, takes on reality star Kaitlyn Bristowe's wedding dress. She challenges her design interns to create a reception gown for the celebrity.

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole.

programme.title: Sister Wives
programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. From their unconventional family structure and living arrangements to financial challenges, each half hour episode exposes the inner workings of a polygamist household, revealing the unexpectedly tight-knit and loving relationships between Kody's wives. The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing.

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals.

programme.title: The Bad Foot Clinic
programme.desc: Severe fungal foot and nail infections, warts, corns, webbed toes, bunions and verrucas are all in a day's work for leading podiatrist Marion Yau and her GP husband Dr Kenny. Together, they tackle extreme and debilitating foot conditions.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Minutes before the noise curfew, a privately chartered Gulfstream III is on final approach to Aspen, Colorado amid heavy snow. And though the plane directly ahead aborts its landing due to poor visibility, AvJet N303GA emerges from the clouds, tries to line up with the single runway, and crashes—instantly claiming the lives of all 18 people on board. With no signs of mechanical failure, investigators learn the plane dropped well below minimum altitude on approach. And though a deep dive into the pilots' backgrounds reveals no red flags, the plane's wreckless trajectory begins to make sense when they look into what happened before the late takeoff from Los Angeles. Client pressure blurred the lines between safety and customer satisfaction. And as a result, the confused pilots were determined to land the plane at Aspen—in spite of the risks. Final

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Just minutes after taking off from Lima, the crew of Aeroperú Flight 603 is overwhelmed by a series of conflicting error messages. Flying blind through thick clouds—and unable to confirm either airspeed or altitude—the pilots don't know which alarm they can trust. A controller steps in and dispatches a rescue plane to guide them back to the airport, but help doesn't arrive in time. And just as the crew is troubleshooting over open ocean, the Boeing 757 plunges into the Pacific, instantly killing everyone on board. A Navy expedition to the sea floor proves the plane was intact when it hit the water and successfully retrieves the plane's black boxes. A single image of the wreckage reveals a minor maintenance glitch with deadly repercussions, while the flight data reveals the crew was ill-prepared for a fatal cascade of erroneous data.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Supercar Megabuild
programme.desc: Car builders Dan Baruffo and Shane Lynch are challenged to design and build a motorbike that can seamlessly match the style and performance of one of the fastest and most exclusive hypercars on the planet - a #2,000,000 McLaren P1. With no bike building experience, the pair must quickly learn how to create a truly special machine if they're to impress the boss and encourage one of his customers part with an eye-watering amount of money.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Its a fact of life. From the minute were born, were all getting older. And while its long been believed that both your body and your brain deteriorate over time, recent studies show that may not always be the case. Some brain functions improve as we get older, while other dont fully develop until later in life! In this episode we explore your brain and how it doesnt always act its age. Through a series of games and experiments, you'll discover how your daily routines might be aging your brain . . . and how you can actually slow down the clock. And if you pay attention, youll discover the surprising answer about whether older brains or younger brains come out on top in this Brain Games "Battle of the Ages".

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: What do you see when you look at the world? Does reality really exist the way you experience it? Your brain is constantly taking in different bits of information all at once to make meaningful patterns that eventually form a complete picture of the world around you. Whether it's light, shadow, distance, or sound, the way your brain perceives this information creates your unique perspective. But have you ever stopped to wonder if your brain is actually being fooled-or if your brain is fooling you? In this episode of Brain Games, you'll see how your brain gets tripped up by odd angles, how light and shadows play a crucial role in your perception of the world, how you can radically shift the way you see reality, and how your brain isn't always as honest with you as you think. Through a series of games and experiments, you'll discover why you shouldn't always believe what you see.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: This is a show about your brain and its imagination. We often associate imagination with creativity and the arts, but we don't always think about how important it is to our daily lives. If you play along you'll see how you can use your imagination to solve daily problems, you'll learn how to tap into the imaginative process, and that, with a little help, you can keep the good ideas flowing. Get ready to unleash your imagination…on Brain Games.

programme.title: Megastructures
programme.desc: Exciting documentary series that shows viewers some extreme and extraordinary construction projects- the biggest, tallest, longest or deepest in the world, and the machines that are used to create such amazing structures. The series features interviews with designers and project managers, who present the problems of construction and the methodology or techniques used to overcome obstacles. Some ''megastructures'' included in the series are US Navy's aircraft carrier, the USS Ronald Reagan, highway with no speed limit built in Germany, undersea tunnel built between France and United Kingdom, world's longest suspension bridge in Japan, twin tower skyscraper in Kuala Lumpur, etc.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: At the Soo Locks in Michigan, one of the most vital gateways in America's industrial chain, the pressure never lets up. Nearly all U.S. iron ore passes through this narrow channel, feeding the steel that powers the nation's economy. As winter tightens its grip, crews face a relentless race against ice, time and extreme conditions to guide the final freighters of the season through the locks. Tugboats maneuver massive vessels with precision while divers and air-bubbler systems work around the clock to keep the channel from freezing shut. At the same time, engineers push forward on a massive construction project, building a new lock designed to secure the future of this critical corridor. Because if the aging Poe Lock fails, the consequences would ripple across the country, threatening jobs, industries and the movement of American steel.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Disasters can strike anywhere, anytime. To find out why, expert analysis of the available evidence is used to recreate real world disasters in cutting edge 3D graphics. We can dissect them, peel back the layers, even freeze time to reveal a disaster's hidden and surprising causes – a paperwork error, a bad glue job, changing a restaurant opening hours. Whatever it is, Disaster Autopsy will uncover it.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: When the twin towers fell in 2001, many engineers thought the era of the skyscraper was over. But the extraordinary catastrophe marked a turning point of a different kind. Safety codes and new understandings were shared internationally, and enthusiasm for tall buildings reached new heights. Construction of supertall buildings — skyscrapers taller than 300 meters — accelerated. Now, there are 71 cities across the world with at least one. Each one, from the One World Trade Center in New York to the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, stands on the shoulders of past failures, hard lessons written in concrete and steel.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Nuclear energy can power whole cities … or level them. Free from carbon emissions and capable of providing baseload power to the existing grid, nuclear is a key tool in the fight against climate change — but the potential for catastrophe is never far from public perception. Despite its reputation, atomic power is one of the safest forms of electricity generation in the world today, thanks to the engineering lessons learned from past accidents. Chernobyl, Fukushima and Three Mile Island have each provided a roadmap to a safer future as atomic scientists work on realizing the ultimate dream: nuclear fusion.

programme.title: UFOs: Investigating the Unknown
programme.desc: Area 51, a military outpost in the desert, shrouded in secrecy for decades, has long been the focus of many Unidentified Aerial Phenomena, or "UAP" rumors. A pop culture phenomenon, Area 51 prompted one Facebook group to suggest storming the facility in search for answers. Civilian UAP groups continue making progress in providing those answers. For the first time since 1969, Congress questions high level officials in the Pentagon on UAPs.

programme.title: UFOs: Investigating the Unknown
programme.desc: For more than five decades the US government has refused to discuss UFOs, but now, Navy pilots tell of seeing mysterious objects tracking their fighter jets – vehicles unlike anything they've ever seen before; top-secret Naval videos are leaked that captivate the world. Government officials, led by former U.S. Senator Harry Reid, demand an investigation. At long last, it looks like the truth about UFOs may finally be revealed.

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: What happens when we die? Is there an afterlife? Does human consciousness survive physical death? These are some of the most baffling questions known to humankind. Nearly every culture and religion seems to believe in some form of "Life after Life." Some people who have been near death report being bathed in images, sounds and feelings so vivid and so real that their lives are changed forever. But are these experiences real, or is it all just a strange last gasp of the human brain?

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: For ages, prophets have suggested that disastrous eventsand maybe even the end of the worldlie ahead. Experts say there is no such thing as the power of foresight and that the predictions are broadly interpreted in order to keep the myth of prophetic ability alive. Are we looking at an unquenchable human desire to make sense out of the chaos of life - or a true Paranatural power?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Three devastating crashes make front page news around the globe, and the media frenzy puts intense pressure on investigators to uncover the true cause of these deadly disasters. On September 11th, 2001, American Airlines Flight 77 disappears from radar and slams into Pentagon. When TWA Flight 800 explodes over Long Island, a media reports spark a four year investigation. And, when an Air France Concorde crashes in Paris just seconds after takeoff, it signals the end of the supersonic era.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: A fire-scarred Great Lakes freighter completes its last journey to a family-run recycling yard on Lake Erie, where turning a dead ship into profit is anything but simple. At MRC's Port Colborne yard, the aging Cuyahoga must be stabilized, stripped and cut apart without contaminating the water or shoreline. Yard manager Jordan Elliott leads a crew working under constant pressure, where time is money and scrap prices can erase profits overnight. The operation hinges on high-risk moments: towing in a powerless ship, navigating brutal financial math, and executing the yard's signature move — using massive rubber airbags to haul the vessel out of the water. It's industrial recycling at full scale, offering a cleaner alternative to global shipbreaking while proving that modern methods can keep steel in circulation without poisoning the future.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: Across southern France, two radically different wind machines pursue the same modern obsession: more speed, more control and almost no margin for error. In Saint-Tropez, SailGP's F50 catamarans — often called Formula One on water — race inches apart on tight courses, where split-second decisions and flawless systems keep disaster at bay. In Leucate, the SP80 team takes a different path, training a kite-powered trimaran built for one purpose only: straight-line speed, with an audacious goal of 150 kilometers per hour. Though their designs diverge, both collide with the same invisible enemy — cavitation. The moment water vaporizes, lift collapses and control vanishes. As sailors, engineers and designers push beyond known limits, wind-driven sport becomes applied engineering, dragging marine technology into an uncertain and faster future.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Rome
programme.desc: An all-female cast of archeologists dig for treasure and find the discovery of the century - a long lost, Colosseum in the Tuscany region. From the bath houses of Pompeii to a sunken seaside resort in the bay of Naples and a hidden amphitheater near Florence, their discoveries bring Rome's vast ancient empire to light in new and exciting ways.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Rome
programme.desc: The Roman war machine spanned all corners of the empire, from Hadrian's Wall in England to Ephesus in Turkey, from the port of Puteoli, which lies south of Rome, up north to Carnuntum in Austria. Once naval dominance of the entire Mediterranean led to the creation of the empire, Rome could shift focus to sustaining its commanding power over the vast territory. Archaeologists unearth a massive military city at a strategic location, deadly weapons from the frontlines, and bones of the victims that dared to attack the edges of the empire. Using ancient designs from the height of Rome's power, they also reconstruct a ship and catapult to test them as proof of the Romans' superior fighting power. They also uncover tombs of gladiators where the power of the imperial propaganda is on full display.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Rome
programme.desc: The Roman Empire was truly global, covering thousands of miles and thousands of inhabitants. New archaeological discoveries paint a clearer picture everyday life back then. A lavish Pompeii villa, preserved in time by the eruption of Vesuvius, showcases the very different lives between the wealthy who lived there and the enslaved who ran the operation. In Jordan, an untouched tomb is uncovered; its art tells the story of the city's history, revealing the cultural melting pot of citizens in a city at the edge of the empire. In that same town, archaeologists analyze the construction of a theater where all citizens were welcome. Final

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Shrouded by mystery, the Lost Treasures of Egypt clears the sand away from your eyes in revealing the secrets of this Ancient Civilisation. From the Valley of Kings to the Pyramids of Giza, we uncover hidden tombs and foretell the stories of ruling pharaohs through the artefacts, that we find along the way. Following the excavations of international experts, we unearth historical context at various archaeological sites. At the end of this series, you should be enlightened with numerous Egyptian theories such as "mummification" and the 'Curse of the Afterlife'. With royalty as Tutankhamun and Cleopatra, we explore the impacts these figures had at the time and the lasting dynasty they have since left behind, for modern Egypt.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: As gateways to eternal life, Egypt's tombs were built to last forever. But thousands of years later, time is winning. In a race to save hidden treasures, archaeological teams excavate the pyramids and burial sites on the verge of collapse. In Abusir, Dr. Mohamed Ishmail Khaled hunts for a long-lost royal chamber, before shifting stones seal it forever. In Philadelphia, Dr. Basem Gehad descends a shaft held up by crumbling sand walls in search of an unexplored tomb. Near Luxor, crews haul debris from a steep, unstable corridor leading to a newly discovered chamber. Every move is a risk to both the archaeologists and the fragile relics they're racing to protect.

programme.title: Tsunami: Race Against Time
programme.desc: The tsunami hits Sri Lanka. Over 1000 miles from the earthquake's epicenter, waves wreck a train and destroy coastal cities. Doctors fight to save every life they can. As disaster spreads across the entire Indian Ocean, journalists race to break the news to the world, and people wake up to the devastating reality that their loved ones have been swept away.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: Two weeks after the explosion, Soviet authorities race to stop a molten nuclear core from poisoning the water table, and clear deadly radioactive fallout across a 30km exclusion zone. Through the summer of 1986, hundreds of thousands of conscripts and volunteers answer the government's call, to brave lethal radiation levels and build a giant concrete sarcophagus around the destroyed reactor. Meanwhile in Vienna, after months of speculation, the world's nuclear experts gather to hear the Soviet account of what caused the catastrophe. Is Gorbachev's promise of Glasnost finally revealing the truth from behind the Iron Curtain? Or could this be the Soviet's biggest cover up yet? Episode Three uncovers the extraordinary battle to build the most perilous construction project in history told by those who those who were there 40 years ago.

programme.title: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
programme.desc: Three days into the flood, rescue operations continue around the clock. Thousands remain trapped, as the government struggles to coordinate a rescue effort. Inside the Superdome, stories of resilience and survival emerge above the sometimes-horrific conditions. Meanwhile, media coverage shifts to emphasize disorder, focusing on looting rather than the thousands still stranded.

programme.title: Secrets of Area 51
programme.desc: Area 51 is renowned for being one of the most top secret sites on earth. After years shrouded in mystery, the CIA released classified information about the missions that took place in years past. This 1 hour special tells the unique perspective of the CIA agents who worked hard to cover up years of secret missions and the employees who worked inside Area 51. What really happens at the most secret military base in the world?

programme.title: UFOs: Investigating the Unknown
programme.desc: Area 51, a military outpost in the desert, shrouded in secrecy for decades, has long been the focus of many Unidentified Aerial Phenomena, or "UAP" rumors. A pop culture phenomenon, Area 51 prompted one Facebook group to suggest storming the facility in search for answers. Civilian UAP groups continue making progress in providing those answers. For the first time since 1969, Congress questions high level officials in the Pentagon on UAPs.

programme.title: UFOs: Investigating the Unknown
programme.desc: For more than five decades the US government has refused to discuss UFOs, but now, Navy pilots tell of seeing mysterious objects tracking their fighter jets – vehicles unlike anything they've ever seen before; top-secret Naval videos are leaked that captivate the world. Government officials, led by former U.S. Senator Harry Reid, demand an investigation. At long last, it looks like the truth about UFOs may finally be revealed.

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: What happens when we die? Is there an afterlife? Does human consciousness survive physical death? These are some of the most baffling questions known to humankind. Nearly every culture and religion seems to believe in some form of "Life after Life." Some people who have been near death report being bathed in images, sounds and feelings so vivid and so real that their lives are changed forever. But are these experiences real, or is it all just a strange last gasp of the human brain?

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: For ages, prophets have suggested that disastrous eventsand maybe even the end of the worldlie ahead. Experts say there is no such thing as the power of foresight and that the predictions are broadly interpreted in order to keep the myth of prophetic ability alive. Are we looking at an unquenchable human desire to make sense out of the chaos of life - or a true Paranatural power?

Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Saksamaa kiirteed on muutunud ühenduslüliks ida ja lääne vahel, kus liiguvad kõiksugu sorti hämarad tegelased ja eluohtlikud laadungid. Kiirteel töötavad politseinikud, kes ohtliku töö tegemisel kohtuvad päevast päeva lapseröövlite, salakaubitsejate, põgenike ja mõrtsukatega.

programme.title: STOP!
programme.desc: Saatejuht Allan Muuk hoiab kätt pulsil liiklusteemadel, mille ring on lai ning pidevas muutumises. Allan toob kokkuvõtlikult välja nädala probleempunktid, kajastades neid nii liiklusspetsialistide kui lihtsa inimese vaatenurgast. Saates jagatud infot täiendavad usaldusväärsed faktid, selgitavad intervjuud ning operatiivsed reportaažid.

programme.title: Üle ja ümber: Autoga Kolumbias
programme.desc: Onu Raiu ja sõbrad on Kolumbias pisut hädas rendiauto iseäraliku probleemiga, mis osutub lausa tervist kahjustavaks. Ent hoopis suuremaks probleemiks saavad teele jäävadrahutused, mis sunnivad seiklejaid uuele marsruudile. Kaunis maastik, omapärasedtualetilahendused linnas, mugavuste leiutamine kitsastes oludes ja soodsad teeäärsedhotellid on osa põnevast seiklusest Venetsueela piiriäärsesse loodusparki.

programme.title: Jääraja päästjad
programme.desc: Thord hoiab rängas lumesajus teed lahti ja see tundub talle täiesti lõppematu tööna.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Paddy ja Freddie suunduvad Borneosse, et seigelda džunglis väga haruldase ja vana autoga. Chris saab sõita maailma luksuslikuma linnamaasturi Rolls-Royce Cullinaniga. Stuudios on külas Bob Mortimer.

programme.title: Olen number neli
programme.desc: Kolm on surnud. Aga kes on number neli? John Smith (Alex Pettyfer) on noor põgenik, kes püüab pääseda teda hävitama saadetud halastamatute vaenlaste eest. Muutes pidevalt oma identiteeti, kolides linnast linna koos oma kaitsja Henriga (Timothy Olyphant), on John alati uus poiss, kel pole mingisugust sidet oma minevikuga. Ühes Ohio väikelinnas, mida ta nüüd koduks nimetab, tabab Johni elu esimene armastus (Dianna Agron), ta avastab endas uued üllatavad võimed ning leiab sideme nendega, kes jagavad ta erakordset saatust.

programme.title: Resident tulnukas
programme.desc: Humoorikas ulmesari Maal hädamaandunud tulnukast Harryst, kes peab salamissiooni jätkamiseks kehastuma Colorado väikelinna arstiks. Inimestega lähemal tutvumisel seisab ta aga moraalse dilemma ees - kas inimkond ikkagi väärib hävitamist?

programme.title: Kuidas ma kohtasin teie ema
programme.desc: Kuidas me kohtasin teie ema (How I Met Your Mother) USA 2005 komöödiasariOsades: Josh Radnor, Jason Segel, Cobie Smulders, Neil Patrick HarrisSelle kultussarja loojateks on Carter Bays ja Craig Thomas ning tegevus keskendub Tedile, kes otsib new Yorgis oma unistuste naist. Abiks on tal selles ta neli parimat sõpra. On aasta 2030. Ted Mosby räägib lugu, kuidas ta kohtas oma tütre ja poja ema. Lugu algab aastal 2005, kui 27-aastane arhitekt Ted, kelle parimad sõbrad Marshall ja Lily kihluvad pärast üheksat aastat kurameerimist, saab elule uue mõtte - leida endale naine. programme.desc: Sari jälgib pukseerimisettevõtteid, kes võistlevad Austraalia kõige karmimate ja tulusaimate lepingute nimel. Need pukseerimisseadmed on ehitatud vastu pidama planeedi kõige heitlikumatele ilmastikutingimustele, olles võimelised vedama tohutuid koormaid ning töötama ohtlikul ja ligipääsmatul maastikul.

programme.title: Jääraja päästjad

programme.title: Räpased romud
programme.desc: Põhja-Carolinas muutub unustatud Crestline rottide kuurordist kuninglikuks sõiduriistaks. Minnesotas üritavad Jeremy ja ta meeskond aastakümnete jagu tolmu ja mustust eriväljaande Mustangist kätte saada.

programme.title: Räpased romud
programme.desc: Minnesotas antakse 1965. aasta Chevy Corvairile uuenduskuur. Georgias muudetakse vana Dodge Ram majesteetlikuks.

programme.title: Sekundiga sajani 2.0
programme.desc: Kas on võimalik veel kiiremini? On võimalik! Eesti kõige kiiremast inimesest Andres Arnoverist sai sellel aastal Euroopa kiireim inimene autoroolis. Ka sellel aastal jälgib dokumentaalsari tema tegemisi kogu hooaja vältel. Eesmärk on suur - tulla kiirendusspordis Euroopa meistriks. Fast Ford Team on selleks valmis. Kas suudetakse taltsutada võimast Ford Mustangit selliselt, et keerulised tehnika kapriisid ei murraks meeskonna vaimu? Sellel teel on väga raskeid hetki, aga ka suuri kordaminekuid. Tegemist on selgelt tehnikaspordis ühe kõige kapriissema ja miks mitte kõige ohtlikuma alaga, sest kiirused on metsikud. Jälgime meeskonna teekonda läbi Euroopa meistrivõistluste etappide.

programme.title: Kalamehejutud
programme.desc: Saate Kalamehejutud peamiseks eesmärgiks on tutvustada erinevate kalaliikide püüdmiseks vajalikke vahendeid, nippe ja kalastuskohti. Kalastushuvilisele inimesele mõeldud saatesarja igas osas keskendutakse ühe Eesti vetes elava kalaliigi püüdmisele ja sellest maitsva roa küpsetamisele. Saatejuhid on Kalev Kruus ja Vladislav Korzets.
